item.title: Life50 - 50个更好生活的建议
item.description: 50 Tips For A Better Life 50个更好生活的建议 | Ideopunk Happiness（幸福） You don’t have to love your job. Jobs are a way to make money. Many people live fine lives in okay jobs by using the money they make on things they care about. 你不必热爱你的工作。工作是一种赚钱的方式。许多人通过用赚来的钱做自己关心的事情，在还算不错的工作中过得很好。 Sturgeon’s law states that 90% of everything is crap. If you dislike poetry, or fine art, or anything, it’s possible you’ve only ever seen the crap. Go looking!
